vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Deep in the jungle, lives a little monkey called Momo.

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Hi! I'm Momo! Ooh ooh, ah ah!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Look! Under the big tree, there is a jar, full of yummy nuts!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Nuts! I love nuts! I want them all!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Hi, Momo! Ooh, nuts! Can we have some too?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Yum! Let's share them!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: No! They're all mine! Mine, mine, mine!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bella and Bobo feel sad. They sit down under the tree.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How would YOU feel, if a friend said no?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Momo pushes his hand into the jar, and grabs a big, big handful of nuts.

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Huh? My hand! It's stuck!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Momo pulls, and pulls, and pulls... but his hand won't come out!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: He hops around with the jar on his hand. Boing, boing, boing!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Help! I can't get my hand out!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Momo feels upset. And he feels a little bit sorry, too.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Momo was greedy. Greedy means, wanting everything just for yourself.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you help Momo? What should he do?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Momo, don't worry. I can help you!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Your hand is full of too many nuts. Let go of some, and take just a few!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: But... I want them all!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: If you hold too many, you can't get any!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Momo opens his hand, lets go of the nuts, and keeps just a few.

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Pop! My hand is free! Thank you, Bobo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Momo looks at his friends. They were so kind to him.

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: I'm sorry I was greedy. There are lots of nuts. Let's share them!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Yay! Thank you, Momo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Momo shares the nuts. Let's count together!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: One for Bella, one for Bobo, one for me!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Two for Bella, two for Bobo, two for me!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Three for Bella, three for Bobo, three for me!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you count Momo's nuts? One, two, three!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Three nuts each! Everybody has the same!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then Bella brings her carrots, and Bobo brings his honey. A big picnic, for everyone!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Sharing is so much better than being stuck!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What else can we share with our friends?

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Toys!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Crayons!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: And hugs! Big hugs!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Take a little, share a lot!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember the story!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: First, Momo wanted all the nuts.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: He took too many, and his hand got stuck.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then, Momo said sorry, and shared with his friends!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Why was Momo's hand stuck?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: He held too many nuts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How did Bella and Bobo feel, when Momo said no?

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Sad!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And how did everyone feel, when Momo shared?

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Happy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What do we say, when we make a mistake?

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: I'm sorry!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now it's your turn! Momo has six bananas. Let's share them with Bella and Bobo.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: One for Bella... one for Bobo... one for Momo.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Two for Bella... two for Bobo... two for Momo.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How many bananas does each friend have?

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Two each! Thank you for sharing!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Take a little, share a lot!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Take a little, share a lot!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: One more time, all together!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Take a little, share a lot!

vo.speaker: momo
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Ooh ooh, ah ah!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Bye-bye!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What can YOU share with a friend today?
